How to correct an already-admitted fact in this AOMS store: append a successor record with `supersedes: <old-record-id>` and DO NOT set the incumbent's claim_key. The store is append-only (in-place content changes are rejected with "append a successor with supersedes instead") and same-id re-writes dedupe as no-ops. If the successor carries the incumbent's claim_key, it enters claim adjudication, gets disposition "contested", and is WITHHELD from recall while the stale incumbent keeps being served — corroborating records do not tip the contest. A plain supersedes-only successor is admitted immediately and recall then suppresses the superseded record. Learned empirically on 2026-08-24 while correcting the staging deploy target record (seed-staging-target -> staging-target-east-1-successor).
